mechanism_fidelity.rationale: The mapping preserves suspected-factor presence, removal and optional safe restoration, observation of disappearance and recurrence, and bounded causal attribution. It retains spontaneous variation, concurrent changes, persistent effects and unsafe rechallenge as limits. Bundle-level attribution preserves the identity of the factor actually perturbed.

target_fidelity.rationale: The procedure provides an explicitly bounded contribution to identifying the responsible deployed change. Contemporaneous controls and comparisons within load and request-mix strata distinguish candidate-associated responses from load variation alone. It expressly withholds an actual culprit identification until observations exist.

operational_coherence.rationale: The specified perturbations can produce measurable latency responses whose controlled comparison warrants increased or decreased support for a causal contribution. Settling windows, safety stops, comparison failure rules and restricted bundle or staging conclusions keep inference within the evidence obtained.

validity.rationale: All three criteria pass for the proposed diagnostic procedure. Missing execution results prevent a present causal finding but do not leave a missing warrant in the mapped procedure.

uncertainty: No observations establish an actual culprit, latency effect size or reproducibility.
Candidate reversibility, experimental safety, cohort comparability and settling times remain unknown; the mapping explicitly constrains execution and inference when these cannot be established.
Any staging-only result has uncertain applicability to production, as the mapping acknowledges.
